name: Ransford Gyasi
title: Product Designer

Excellent at transforming complex needs into scalable design systems, high-fidelity prototypes, and accessible interfaces. Proven collaborator in Agile environments, driving brand consistency, faster delivery, and measurable business results for millions of users.
